verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a workflow orchestration engine, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no workflow versioning, change review, or rollback feature. Hot-reloading workers on code changes, environment profiles and enterprise audit logs are adjacent features, not version history with review and rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
